summary: The robots file contains instructions for web crawlers to not access any part of the website.
purpose: To restrict web crawlers from accessing any portion of the website by using a disallow directive.

workflows.name: Restrict Web Crawling
steps: Web crawler accesses the robots.txt file.
Web crawler reads the directive 'User-agent: *' which applies to all web crawlers.
Web crawler reads the directive 'Disallow: /' indicating it should not access any directories.
Web crawler complies by not crawling any part of the site.

business_rules: All web crawlers are restricted from accessing any part of the site.
system_behavior: Web crawlers must adhere to the directives specified in the robots.txt file.
